herb_attributes.dosage: Internal: decoction 1.5–3 g; powdered 0.6–0.9 g. External: appropriate amount, pounded and applied.
herb_attributes.preparation_method: Remove leaves and fibrous roots, wash clean, use fresh or slice and sun-dry.
herb_attributes.contraindications: Contraindicated in pregnancy; toxic — reports of poisoning; stop medicine immediately and provide timely rescue if poisoning occurs.
